overall_reason: One UI sans (Segoe UI drawn at 1440, from a -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI" stack; system-ui at 375) sets every role, which fits a product component in Operate mode, so TYP-005 does not apply. The row names (14px/500) and timestamps (12px) are set well, but the 11px meta lines are cut off at the column edge with no ellipsis: 'perf/search · b41e09d · J' loses 'on Park · 42s'.

score.reason: T-LEADING fails on clipped meta text in the rows (TYP-022, Floor, which caps the score at 4); T-LADDER also finds the head and row names one weight apart.

findings.title: Lines never collide or clip
findings.where: span.st-meta in the deploy rows, 1440 and 375
findings.evidence: The DOM text is 'perf/search · b41e09d · Jon Park · 42s' (38 characters at 11px) in a 120px box; the screenshot shows 'perf/search · b41e09d · J' (01-evidence/tiles/1440-00.png, second row), and at 375 the first row ends 'Maya Chen ·' with '42s' cut (01-evidence/tiles/375-00.png). No ellipsis marks the cut.
findings.before: Meta runs past its column and is cut mid-name with no ellipsis
findings.after: Let the meta line wrap or drop fields (the hash or the duration) so it fits; if it must truncate, end on an ellipsis and expose the full text
findings.why: The reader sees 'J' instead of the author's name and cannot tell the text was cut.

findings.title: Weight steps are clear
findings.where: card head 'Recent deploys' against row names, 1440
findings.evidence: 'Recent deploys' is 14px/600 and the row names 14px/500.
findings.after: Separate the head by size or by a clear weight step (400 rows under a 600 head)
findings.why: A 500 to 600 step at one size does not read as hierarchy.

strengths: The status badges 'Live', 'Building' and 'Failed' share one 10px/600 setting.
Timestamps share one 12px/400 setting and the stylesheet sets tabular-nums.
not_investigated: T-MEASURE: no paragraph of 3 or more lines at either width (type table measure.paragraphs = 0)
